definitions.name: forestWork
source_context_lines: open RMAF ForestState Universal233 Universal233.CoreProgram Universal233.PaidQueries Universal233.SourceCoverage
definitions.code:
def forestWork (ordinary : Ordinary) (W : OrdinaryWork) (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) (q : Nat) : Nat :=
 nonrecursiveBill ordinary W T ss q+
 if proper T ss && !agrees T ss (ss.map leaves) then
  match T,ss with
  | none,_ => 0
  | some _,[_] => 0
  | some t,_ => match overlap t ss with
    | none => 0
    | some h => ((branches t ss h q).map fun io=>
     let d := io.2.sourceCuts.length
     if _hd : 1≤d ∧ d≤q then forestWork ordinary W T (replace ss io.1 io.2.partition) (q-d)
     else 0).sum
 else 0

termination_interface.required_proposition: For the recursive arm 1 <= d and d <= q, q-d < q. Termination proof value omitted; no axiom introduced.

definitions.name: generationBill
source_context_lines: open RMAF RestrictionBridge ForestState OutputState ForestGroups VertexGeometry
definitions.code:
def generationBill (t : Tree) (ss : List Tree) (i : Nat) (v : RMAF.Vertex) (q : Nat) : Nat :=
  match ss[i]? with
  | none => 1
  | some s =>
    (meterGenerate s (colorLabel t v) q).measured.work +
      ((leaves s).map fun x => (meterColorLabel t v x).work).sum

definitions.name: inspectionBill
source_context_lines: open RMAF RestrictionBridge ForestState OutputState ForestGroups VertexGeometry
definitions.code:
def inspectionBill (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) (q : Nat) : Nat :=
  4096 * (targetNodes T + sourceNodes ss + ss.length + q + 1)^8

definitions.name: materializationBill
source_context_lines: open RMAF RestrictionBridge ForestState OutputState ForestGroups VertexGeometry
definitions.code:
def materializationBill (t : Tree) (ss : List Tree) (q i : Nat) (o : Output) : Nat :=
  inspectionBill (some t) ss q +
  inspectionBill (some t) (replace ss i o.partition) (q-o.sourceCuts.length) +
  256 * (o.partition.flatten.length + (o.sourceCuts.map List.length).sum + sourceNodes ss + 1)^4

definitions.name: nonrecursiveBill
source_context_lines: open RMAF RestrictionBridge ForestState OutputState ForestGroups VertexGeometry
definitions.code:
def nonrecursiveBill (ordinary : Tree → Tree → Nat → Option Forest)
    (ordinaryWork : Tree → Tree → Nat → Nat) (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) (q : Nat) : Nat :=
  inspectionBill T ss q +
  if proper T ss && !agrees T ss (ss.map leaves) then
    match T, ss with
    | none, _ => 0
    | some t, [s] => ordinaryWork t s q
    | some t, _ => match overlap t ss with
      | none => match jobs t ss with
        | none => 0
        | some js =>
          let m := meterSchedule
            (fun p b => (ordinary p.1 p.2 b).map (fun F => (F.length-1,F)))
            (fun p b => ordinaryWork p.1 p.2 b) q js
          m.callerWork + m.recursiveWork
      | some h => overlapBill t ss + generationBill t ss h.left h.vertex q +
          generationBill t ss h.right h.vertex q +
          ((branches t ss h q).map fun io => materializationBill t ss q io.1 io.2).sum +
          inspectionBill T ss q * ((branches t ss h q).length+1)
  else 0

definitions.name: overlapBill
source_context_lines: open RMAF RestrictionBridge ForestState OutputState ForestGroups VertexGeometry
definitions.code:
def overlapBill (t : Tree) (ss : List Tree) : Nat :=
  (ss.map fun a => (ss.map fun b =>
    (meterMinimal (leaves a) t).work + (meterMinimal (leaves b) t).work +
    16 * (treeNodes t+1)^3).sum).sum

definitions.name: Universal233.PaidQueries.MeterReceipt
definitions.code:
structure MeterReceipt (P A : Type) where
  value : Receipt A
  queries : List (P × Nat)
  callerWork : Nat
  recursiveWork : Nat

definitions.name: Universal233.PaidQueries.meterRun
definitions.code:
def meterRun (solve : P → Nat → Option (Nat × A)) (charge : P → Nat → Nat)
    (b : Nat) : List (Job P A) → MeterReceipt P A
  | [] => ⟨⟨some [],[],0⟩,[],2,0⟩
  | .resolved _ c a :: js =>
    let r := meterRun solve charge b js
    ⟨⟨r.value.answers.map ((c,a)::·),r.value.calls,r.value.visits+1⟩,
      r.queries,r.callerWork+5,r.recursiveWork⟩
  | .hard p :: js =>
    match solve p b with
    | none => ⟨⟨none,[b],1⟩,[(p,b)],8,charge p b⟩
    | some x =>
      let r := meterRun solve charge b js
      ⟨⟨r.value.answers.map (x::·),b::r.value.calls,r.value.visits+1⟩,
        (p,b)::r.queries,r.callerWork+8,charge p b+r.recursiveWork⟩

definitions.name: Universal233.PaidQueries.postCharge
definitions.code:
def postCharge (r : Receipt A) : Nat := match r.answers with
  | none => 4
  | some xs => 4*xs.length+4

definitions.name: Universal233.PaidQueries.meterSchedule
definitions.code:
def meterSchedule (solve : P → Nat → Option (Nat × A)) (charge : P → Nat → Nat)
    (q : Nat) (js : List (Job P A)) : MeterReceipt P A :=
  if q < knownCost js + 2*pending js then
    ⟨⟨none,[],0⟩,[],8*js.length+8,0⟩ else
    let r := meterRun solve charge (allocated q js) js
    ⟨⟨r.value.answers.bind (fun xs => if answerCost xs ≤ q then some xs else none),
        r.value.calls,r.value.visits⟩,r.queries,
      16*js.length+20+r.callerWork+postCharge r.value,r.recursiveWork⟩

  prunedCalls : Nat
  deriving Repr

definitions.name: Universal233.CoreWork.meterGenerate
definitions.code:
def meterGenerate (t : Tree) (color : Nat → Nat) (budget : Nat) : Generated :=
  if (leaves t).Nodup then
    let init := meterFromTree color [] t
    let r := meterRun (min budget ((leaves t).length-1)) init.tree [] []
    ⟨{r with work := initialCharge t+r.work},init.oracleCalls⟩
  else ⟨⟨⟨[],["duplicate original label"],0,0,0⟩,initialCharge t,0,0⟩,0⟩

definitions.name: Universal233.CoreWork.meterFromTree
definitions.code:
def meterFromTree (color : Nat → Nat) (p : Vertex) : Tree → Initial
  | .leaf x => ⟨.leaf ⟨p,[x],color x⟩,1⟩
  | .node l r =>
    let a := meterFromTree color (p++[false]) l
    let b := meterFromTree color (p++[true]) r
    ⟨.node p a.tree b.tree,a.oracleCalls+b.oracleCalls⟩

definitions.name: Universal233.CoreWork.meterRun
definitions.code:
def meterRun : Nat → GTree → List Group → List Vertex → Measured
  | 0 => meterStep (fun _ _ _ => ⟨⟨[],[],0,0,1⟩,1,0,1⟩)
  | q+1 => meterStep (meterRun q)

definitions.name: Universal233.CoreWork.meterStep
definitions.code:
def meterStep (f : GTree → List Group → List Vertex → Measured)
    (current : GTree) (d : List Group) (c : List Vertex) : Measured :=
  let t := normalize current
  let charge := localCharge current d c
  match choose t with
  | .finish =>
    ⟨⟨[⟨d.map Group.labels ++ [(groups t).flatMap Group.labels],c⟩],[],1,0,0⟩,charge,0,0⟩
  | .one g =>
    let r := meterAttempt f t d c g
    ⟨prefixRoot r.receipt, charge + r.work,r.copied,r.prunedCalls⟩
  | .two a b =>
    let ra := meterAttempt f t d c a
    let rb := meterAttempt f t d c b
    let copies := appendCells ra.receipt
    ⟨prefixRoot (combine ra.receipt rb.receipt), charge + ra.work + rb.work + copies,
      ra.copied + rb.copied + copies,ra.prunedCalls + rb.prunedCalls⟩
  | .refuse why => ⟨⟨[],[why],1,0,0⟩,charge,0,0⟩

definitions.code: def initialCharge (t : Tree) : Nat := 128*(treeNodes t+1)^3

definitions.name: Universal233.CoreWork.inputResource
definitions.code:
def inputResource (t : Tree) : Nat :=
  treeNodes t*(treeNodes t+2) + treeNodes t+1

definitions.name: Universal233.CoreWork.localCharge
definitions.code:
def localCharge (t : GTree) (d : List Group) (c : List Vertex) : Nat :=
  256 * (footprint t + d.length + c.length + 1)^3

definitions.name: Universal233.CoreWork.footprint
definitions.code:
def footprint : GTree → Nat
  | .leaf g => 1 + g.labels.length + g.origin.length
  | .node p l r => 1 + p.length + footprint l + footprint r

definitions.name: Universal233.CoreWork.appendCells
definitions.code: def appendCells (a : Receipt) : Nat := a.outputs.length + a.refusals.length

def childForestDebit (actual : GenericForest.FrontierWork.Ordinary) (W : OrdinaryWork) (T : Tree) (q : Nat) (cs : List Child) : Nat :=
 ((Rule5OrdinaryDispatch.forestJobs T q cs).map fun j=>forestWork actual W j.target j.sources j.residual).sum
